response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, SUM(derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT s.invoice_number, s.average_quantity, s.relative_gap, s.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10
